title: Courier Charge for Vehicle Purchase Agreements Originals Signed at the Buyer's Address
content:
**Rate.** For a signed order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements that is not an exchange replacement, originals signed at the buyer's address are couriered, and a courier charge is added to the documentation fee. The charge follows the fulfillment method of the order's handover appointment in Delivery & Pickup Appointments.

| Handover appointment | Courier charge |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery or Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery | $49.50 (the long-route courier charge) |
| Kestrel Local Home Delivery | $24.50 (the local courier charge) |
| Kestrel Hub Pickup, Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup, Kestrel Fly & Drive, or no appointment | none |

**Hypothetical cases.**
- Delivery booked as Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery: $49.50.
- Delivery booked as Kestrel Local Home Delivery: $24.50.
- Collection at a Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup: none.
